subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use since/for and the Present continuous for plans.
Answer the WOW! question: How can people and places entertain us?

tf.s: The WOW! question for Unit 1 is: How can people and places entertain us?
tf.why: Yes, that is the Unit 1 question.

tf.s: The girl who wants to be a make-up artist loves art.
tf.why: Yes, she helped paint everyone's faces at a family party.

tf.s: We say “I've written a diary for I was seven.”
tf.why: I was seven is a point in time: since I was seven.

tf.s: “In July we are flying to Cairo” is a future arrangement.
tf.why: In July shows a fixed future plan.

tf.s: You go bowling at an ice rink.
tf.why: You go bowling at a bowling alley.

tf.s: “Ali has played football for five years” is correct.
tf.why: Five years is a period, so we use for.

tf.s: A costume designer makes clothes for performers.
tf.why: Yes, costumes are clothes for shows.

tf.s: Planetariums and museums can help us learn in a fun way.
tf.why: Yes, places can entertain and teach us.

tf.s: The Present continuous for plans is have + past participle.
A comedian works behind the camera and videos the show.
tf.why: A camera operator videos the show; a comedian tells jokes.

boxes.q: I've written a diary ___ I was seven.
boxes.why: I was seven is a point in time.

boxes.q: Ali has played football ___ five years.
boxes.why: Five years is a period of time.

boxes.q: Which sentence is a future plan?
o: I'm visiting my aunt on Friday.
I visit my aunt every day.
boxes.why: On Friday shows a future arrangement.

boxes.q: Where can you watch films with special glasses?
How long ___ you known your best friend?
Which job puts make-up on actors?

mcq.q: What is the Unit 1 WOW! question?
o: How can people and places entertain us?

mcq.q: Who wants to be a make-up artist, and why?
o: The girl who loves art and painted faces at a family party
mcq.why: Her comment tells us she loves art.

mcq.q: Which place do you go to for bowling?
Which form is used for future arrangements in Unit 1?
mcq.why: For example: We're watching a show on Tuesday.

mcq.q: Complete: I've written a diary ___ I was seven.
mcq.why: I was seven is a point in time.

mcq.q: Write a sentence about a friend with the Present perfect and for.
o: Ali has played football for five years.
Ali played football for five years ago.
Ali has played football since five years.
mcq.why: Has + past participle + for + a period.

mcq.q: Complete: In July we ___ (fly) to Cairo.
mcq.why: In July is a future arrangement.

mcq.q: Which answer to the WOW! question is the best?
o: Performers make us laugh, and places like museums help us learn in a fun way.
We travel by plane and bus.
mcq.why: It talks about people and places that entertain us.

o: He has been a stunt performer since ten years.
She has been a presenter since 2018.
I've known him for two years.
mcq.why: Ten years is a period, so it should be for.

mcq.q: A reader says: I love making clothes for our school plays. Which job suits this reader?
mcq.why: Costume designers make clothes for performers.
